methods.name: hasAttached
methods.description: Whether this host has an attached portal.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Permanently dispose of this portal host.

properties.name: component
properties.description: The type of the component that will be instantiated for attachment.

properties.name: viewContainerRef
properties.description:
[Optional] Where the attached component should live in Angular's *logical* component tree.
This is different from where the component *renders*, which is determined by the PortalOutlet.
The origin is necessary when the host is outside of the Angular application context.

properties.name: injector
properties.description: [Optional] Injector used for the instantiation of the component.

properties.name: componentFactoryResolver
properties.description:
Alternate `ComponentFactoryResolver` to use when resolving the associated component.
Defaults to using the resolver from the outlet that the portal is attached to.

exports.name: KeyboardShortcutComponent
exports.summary:
Declarative wrapper around {@link KeyboardShortcutsService.add}: registers a shortcut for
the projected content's lifetime and emits `fire` when it's triggered.
exports.summaryZh:
{@link KeyboardShortcutsService.add} 的声明式封装：在投影内容存续期间注册快捷键，
触发时发出 `fire` 事件。

inputs.name: description
inputs.descriptionZh: 快捷键的描述文字（显示在帮助面板中）。

inputs.name: label
inputs.descriptionZh: 快捷键的分组/标签文字（显示在帮助面板中）。

inputs.name: preventDefault
inputs.descriptionZh: 触发时是否阻止按键的默认行为。

inputs.name: allowIn
inputs.descriptionZh: 允许该快捷键在哪些元素类型（如 input、textarea、select）内触发。

inputs.name: key
inputs.descriptionZh: 触发该快捷键的按键组合，可以是单个或多个。

inputs.name: target
inputs.descriptionZh: 监听按键事件的目标元素，默认为整个文档。

inputs.name: throttleTime
inputs.descriptionZh: 触发节流时间（毫秒）。

exports.name: KeyboardShortcutsComponent
exports.summary:
Declarative wrapper around {@link KeyboardShortcutsService}: bind a list of shortcuts via
the `shortcuts` input and they are registered/unregistered automatically with this component's
lifecycle.
exports.summaryZh:
{@link KeyboardShortcutsService} 的声明式封装：通过 `shortcuts` 输入属性绑定一组快捷键，
它们会随本组件的生命周期自动注册/注销。

inputs.name: shortcuts
inputs.description: The shortcut(s) to register while this component is alive and not disabled.
inputs.descriptionZh: 本组件存活且未被禁用期间要注册的快捷键。

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables (and unregisters) all shortcuts when set to true.
inputs.descriptionZh: 设为 true 时禁用（并注销）全部快捷键。

methods.name: select
methods.description: Returns an observable that emits whenever the shortcut with the given key fires.
methods.descriptionZh: 返回一个 Observable，在给定按键组合的快捷键被触发时发出事件。

exports.name: KeyboardShortcutsDirective
exports.summary:
Registers a list of {@link KeyboardShortcutsService} shortcuts (`ngKeyboardShortcuts`) scoped
to the host element, re-registering whenever the input changes and toggleable via `disabled`.
exports.summaryZh:
注册一组作用域限定于宿主元素的 {@link KeyboardShortcutsService} 快捷键
（`ngKeyboardShortcuts`），输入变化时会重新注册，并可通过 `disabled` 开关。

inputs.name: ngKeyboardShortcuts
inputs.description:
The shortcut(s) to register, scoped to the host element (auto-allowed inside
select/input/textarea elements).
inputs.descriptionZh: 要注册的快捷键，作用域限定于宿主元素（自动允许在 select/input/textarea 元素内触发）。

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables (and unregisters) all shortcuts when set to `true`.
inputs.descriptionZh: 设为 `true` 时禁用（并注销）全部快捷键。

exports.name: KeyboardShortcutsHelpComponent
exports.summary:
A slide-in panel (attached to `document.body` via a portal) that lists all currently
registered keyboard shortcuts, grouped by label. Toggle it with the `key` input shortcut.
exports.summaryZh:
一个滑入式面板（通过 portal 附加到 `document.body`），按分组标签列出当前已注册的全部快捷键。
通过 `key` 输入属性指定的快捷键来切换显示。

inputs.name: disableScrolling
inputs.description: Disables page scrolling while the help panel is open.
inputs.descriptionZh: 帮助面板打开期间禁用页面滚动。

inputs.name: keyDescription
inputs.descriptionZh: 切换本帮助面板的快捷键在帮助列表中显示的描述文字。

inputs.name: keyLabel
inputs.descriptionZh: 切换本帮助面板的快捷键在帮助列表中显示的分组标签。

inputs.name: closeKeyLabel
inputs.descriptionZh: 关闭快捷键在帮助列表中显示的分组标签。

inputs.name: closeKeyDescription
inputs.descriptionZh: 关闭快捷键在帮助列表中显示的描述文字。

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: The shortcut key that toggles this help panel (e.g. `'shift+?'`).
inputs.descriptionZh: 用于切换本帮助面板的快捷键（例如 `'shift+?'`）。

inputs.name: closeKey
inputs.description: The shortcut key that closes this help panel (registered/re-registered on change).
inputs.descriptionZh: 用于关闭本帮助面板的快捷键（变化时会重新注册）。

inputs.name: title
inputs.descriptionZh: 帮助面板的标题（翻译键）。

inputs.name: emptyMessage
inputs.descriptionZh: 没有已注册快捷键时显示的提示信息（翻译键）。

methods.name: reveal
methods.description: Shows the help panel (attaching it to `document.body` via a portal).
methods.descriptionZh: 显示帮助面板（通过 portal 将其附加到 `document.body`）。

methods.name: visible
methods.description: Whether the help panel is currently attached/visible.
methods.descriptionZh: 帮助面板当前是否已附加/可见。

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the help panel (detaching it from the DOM).
methods.descriptionZh: 隐藏帮助面板（将其从 DOM 中分离）。

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the help panel between shown and hidden.
methods.descriptionZh: 在显示与隐藏之间切换帮助面板。

properties.name: className
properties.descriptionZh: 应用到帮助面板宿主元素上的 CSS 类名。

properties.name: template
properties.descriptionZh: 面板内容的模板引用，通过 portal 挂载到 `document.body`。

properties.name: shortcuts
properties.type: Record<"label", { key: string[]; label: string; description: string }[]>
properties.descriptionZh: 按标签分组后的已注册快捷键。

properties.name: showing$
properties.descriptionZh: 帮助面板当前是否正在显示。

properties.name: labels
properties.descriptionZh: 已注册快捷键的分组标签列表。

exports.name: KeyboardShortcutsHelpItemComponent
exports.summary:
Renders a single {@link Shortcut} entry (key combo + label) inside the keyboard shortcuts
help list, translating raw key codes into display symbols.
exports.summaryZh:
在快捷键帮助列表中渲染单条 {@link Shortcut}（按键组合 + 标签），
将原始按键码转换为可展示的符号。

inputs.name: index
inputs.descriptionZh: 该条目在列表中的索引。

inputs.name: shortcut
inputs.description: The shortcut entry to render; setting it parses its key combo(s) into display symbols.
inputs.descriptionZh: 待渲染的快捷键条目；设置时会将其按键组合解析为可展示的符号。

properties.name: parsedKeys
properties.descriptionZh: 解析后的按键组合，按符号数组分组，便于逐个渲染按键图标。

properties.name: shortcut
properties.descriptionZh: 当前渲染的快捷键条目。

exports.name: KeyboardShortcutsHelpService
exports.summary:
Exposes an observable list of registered {@link KeyboardShortcutsService} shortcuts that
have both a `label` and `description`, suitable for rendering in a help/cheat-sheet panel.
exports.summaryZh:
暴露一个可观察的快捷键列表（来自 {@link KeyboardShortcutsService}），
仅包含同时具有 `label` 和 `description` 的项，适合在帮助/速查面板中展示。

properties.name: shortcuts$
properties.description: Emits the list of registered shortcuts that have both a `label` and `description`.
properties.descriptionZh: 发出同时具有 `label` 和 `description` 的已注册快捷键列表。

exports.name: KeyboardShortcutsPlugin
exports.summary:
Angular `EventManager` plugin that lets templates bind shortcuts declaratively via
`(shortcut.<key>.<description>.<label>)="handler()"` (optionally `.prevent`), backed by
{@link KeyboardShortcutsService}.
exports.summaryZh:
Angular `EventManager` 插件，允许模板通过
`(shortcut.<key>.<description>.<label>)="handler()"`（可加 `.prevent`）声明式绑定快捷键，
底层基于 {@link KeyboardShortcutsService}。

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Whether this plugin handles the given event name (any event containing `.shortcut.`).
methods.descriptionZh: 判断该插件是否处理给定事件名称（包含 `.shortcut.` 的任意事件）。

methods.name: addEventListener
methods.description:
Parses a `shortcut.<key>.<description>.<label>` event binding and registers the
corresponding keyboard shortcut, returning an unregister function.
methods.descriptionZh:
解析 `shortcut.<key>.<description>.<label>` 事件绑定，注册对应的键盘快捷键，
并返回一个用于注销的函数。

properties.name: manager
properties.descriptionZh: Angular 注入的事件管理器，用于委托不支持的事件类型。

exports.name: KeyboardShortcutsSelectService
exports.summary:
Thin wrapper exposing {@link KeyboardShortcutsService.select} for programmatically
triggering a registered shortcut by key.
exports.summaryZh: 轻量封装，暴露 {@link KeyboardShortcutsService.select}，用于按键值以编程方式触发已注册的快捷键。

methods.name: select
methods.description: Returns an observable that emits whenever the shortcut registered under `key` fires.
methods.descriptionZh: 返回一个 Observable，当以 `key` 注册的快捷键被触发时发出。

exports.name: KeyboardShortcutsService
exports.summary:
Registers global keyboard shortcuts (single combos and multi-key sequences) and dispatches
matching commands, respecting focus context (e.g. ignoring shortcuts while typing in inputs).
exports.summaryZh:
注册全局键盘快捷键（单个组合键和多键序列），并在匹配时派发对应命令，同时会根据焦点上下文
做出忽略处理（例如在输入框内输入时忽略快捷键）。

methods.name: add
methods.description: Registers one or more shortcuts and returns their generated ids (for later removal).
methods.descriptionZh: 注册一个或多个快捷键，返回其生成的 id（用于后续移除）。

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Unregisters shortcuts by the ids returned from {@link add}.
methods.descriptionZh: 按 {@link add} 返回的 id 注销快捷键。

methods.name: select
methods.description: Returns an observable that emits whenever the shortcut registered under `key` fires.
methods.descriptionZh: 返回一个 observable，当以 `key` 注册的快捷键被触发时发出通知。

properties.name: pressed$
properties.descriptionZh: 每当任意已注册快捷键被触发时发出事件（含触发的按键与原生事件）。

properties.name: shortcuts$
properties.descriptionZh: 发出当前已注册的（非空）快捷键列表，随注册/注销更新。

properties.name: shortcuts
properties.descriptionZh: 当前已注册的非序列型快捷键。

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attach this portal to a host.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detach this portal from its host

methods.name: setAttachedHost
methods.description:
Sets the PortalOutlet reference without performing `attach()`. This is used directly by
the PortalOutlet when it is performing an `attach()` or `detach()`.

properties.name: isAttached
properties.description: Whether this portal is attached to a host.

exports.name: ShortcutEventOutput
exports.summary: The output type fired by the command when shortcut is triggered.

exports.name: ShortcutInput
exports.summary: The shortcut input type for ng-keyboard-shortcuts component

methods.name: attach
methods.description:
Attach the portal to the provided `PortalOutlet`.
When a context is provided it will override the `context` property of the `TemplatePortal`
instance.

properties.name: templateRef
properties.description: The embedded template that will be used to instantiate an embedded View in the host.

properties.name: viewContainerRef
properties.description: Reference to the ViewContainer into which the template will be stamped out.

properties.name: context
properties.description: Contextual data to be passed in to the embedded view.
